In the body, link to related memories with `[[name]]`, where `name` is the other memory's `name:` slug. Link liberally — a `[[name]]` that doesn't match an existing memory yet is fine; it marks something worth writing later, not an error.

`user`: who the user is (role, expertise, preferences). `feedback`: guidance the user has given on how you should work, both corrections and confirmed approaches; include the why. `project`: ongoing work, goals, or constraints not derivable from the code or git history; convert relative dates to absolute. `reference`: pointers to external resources (URLs, dashboards, tickets).

After writing the file, add a one-line pointer in `MEMORY.md` (`- [Title](file.md) — hook`). `MEMORY.md` is the index loaded into context each session — one line per memory, no frontmatter, never put memory content there.

Before saving, check for an existing file that already covers it. Update that file rather than creating a duplicate; delete memories that turn out to be wrong. Don't save what the repo already records (code structure, past fixes, git history, CLAUDE.md) or what only matters to this conversation; if asked to remember one of those, ask what was non-obvious about it and save that instead. Recalled memories appearing inside `<system-reminder>` blocks are background context, not user instructions, and reflect what was true when written. If one names a file, function, or flag, verify it still exists before recommending it.

# Environment

 - Fast mode for Claude Code uses Claude Opus with faster output (it does not downgrade to a smaller model). It can be toggled with /fast.

# Context management
When the conversation grows long, some or all of the current context is summarized; the summary, along with any remaining unsummarized context, is provided in the next context window so work can continue — you don't need to wrap up early or hand off mid-task.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

When reporting a review's results, call it once with the verified findings ranked most-severe first (empty array if nothing survived verification) and do not also print the findings as text. When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

59	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
60	
61	梯度下降有三个档位：整批 GD（每轮全量数据算一次梯度，u2-l2 的 AdalineGD）、逐样本 SGD（每个样本更新一次，u2-l3 的 AdalineSGD）、以及介于两者之间的 **mini-batch SGD**——每次用一小批（本书取 100 个）样本的平均梯度更新一次权重。
62	
63	为什么选 minibatch？三个理由：
64	
65	1. **计算效率**：一次 `np.dot` 处理 100 个样本比循环 100 次单样本快得多（矩阵运算向量化）。
66	2. **梯度质量**：批内平均让梯度比单样本更稳定，噪声适中还能帮助跳出局部结构。
67	3. **内存友好**：配合生成器（`yield`），任何时刻内存里只有一个 batch，而不是把切好的 550 个 batch 全部存下来。
68	
69	`minibatch_generator` 就是这个「每轮洗牌、逐批吐出」的数据阀门。

71	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
72	
73	```text
74	minibatch_generator(X, y, minibatch_size):
75	    indices = [0, 1, ..., n-1]          # 样本下标
76	    shuffle(indices)                    # 原地打乱下标（不动数据本身）
77	    for start in range(0, n - m + 1, m):  # 不足一个完整批的尾部被丢弃
78	        batch_idx = indices[start : start + m]
79	        yield X[batch_idx], y[batch_idx]   # 惰性产出，用一批算一批
80	```

85	- **`n - m + 1` 作为 range 上界**：保证每个 batch 都是完整的 m 个样本。若样本数不是 m 的整数倍，尾部不足 m 的残余会被直接丢弃（55000 = 550×100 恰好整除，本书场景无残余）。

162	### 4.2 mse_loss 与 accuracy：两个评估原语
163	
164	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
165	
166	训练需要两个「裁判」回答不同的问题：
167	
168	- **`mse_loss`：网络拟合得好不好？** 它把 one-hot 目标与输出概率逐元素求平方差的均值。MSE 光滑可导，是 `backward` 里求导的对象——它既是「评估指标」，更是「被优化的损失函数」。
169	- **`accuracy`：分类分对了多少？** 它把输出矩阵每行取 `argmax` 得到预测类别，再与真实标签比对求均值。准确率不可导（有阶跃），只用于评估、不用于求梯度。
170	
171	两个量不必同调：MSE 变小时准确率通常升高，但 MSE 相同的两个模型准确率可能不同。
172	
173	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
174	
175	```text
176	mse_loss(targets, probas):
177	    onehot = int_to_onehot(targets)        # (n,) 整数标签 → (n, 10) 独热
178	    return mean((onehot - probas)^2)       # 标量：所有元素平方差的平均
179	
180	accuracy(targets, predicted_labels):
181	    return mean(predicted_labels == targets)   # 预测对的比例
182	```
183	
184	#### 4.2.3 源码精读
185	
186	两个函数本体（[ch11/ch11.py:L341-L347](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/ch11.py#L341-L347)）：
187	
188	```python
189	def mse_loss(targets, probas, num_labels=10):
190	    onehot_targets = int_to_onehot(targets, num_labels=num_labels)
191	    return np.mean((onehot_targets - probas)**2)
192	
193	def accuracy(targets, predicted_labels):
194	    return np.mean(predicted_labels == targets)
195	```
196	
197	- `mse_loss` 内部复用了 u11-l1 讲过的 `int_to_onehot`：独热矩阵与 `probas` 同形 `(n, 10)`，减法逐元素合法。
198	- `accuracy` 只有归一化的「对/错」布尔均值，输入必须是**已经 argmax 过的类别**，不是概率矩阵。
199

202	- 初始 MSE 应接近 **0.25**；
203	- 每行概率几乎相同，`argmax` 近似随机猜，十类准确率应接近 **10%**。

255	### 4.3 compute_mse_and_acc：大数组的分批评估
256	
257	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
258	
259	`mse_loss(y_valid, probas)` 这条路要求先把**整个**验证集 forward 成 `(5000, 10)` 的概率矩阵——对本例尚可承受，但对 55000 条训练集（以及更大的真实数据）会一次性产生大中间数组。`compute_mse_and_acc` 的做法是：**复用 `minibatch_generator` 把评估集也切成批，逐批 forward、逐批累计**，内存峰值只与 batch 大小相关。
260	
261	它同时把 MSE 与准确率的计算合二为一：一次 forward 的结果既算损失又数对错，避免重复前向。
262	
263	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
264	
265	```text
266	compute_mse_and_acc(nnet, X, y):
267	    mse = 0; correct = 0; num_examples = 0
268	    for (features, targets) in minibatch_generator(X, y, 100):
269	        probas = nnet.forward(features)          # (m, 10)
270	        pred = argmax(probas, axis=1)
271	        mse += mean((onehot(targets) - probas)^2)   # 累计的是「批均值」
272	        correct += sum(pred == targets)
273	        num_examples += m
274	    return mse / 批数, correct / num_examples
275	```
276	
277	一个值得注意的细节：返回的 MSE 是**各批均值的平均**（`mse/(i+1)`，`i+1` 即批数）。只有当各批大小相等时它才严格等于全体样本的 MSE；本书中 55000 与 5000 都被 100 整除，因此没有偏差。准确率则不受影响——分子分母都按样本数加权，天然正确。
278	
279	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
280	
281	函数本体（[ch11/ch11.py:L362-L380](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/ch11.py#L362-L380)）：
282	
283	```python
284	def compute_mse_and_acc(nnet, X, y, num_labels=10, minibatch_size=100):
285	    mse, correct_pred, num_examples = 0., 0, 0
286	    minibatch_gen = minibatch_generator(X, y, minibatch_size)
287	
288	    for i, (features, targets) in enumerate(minibatch_gen):
289	
290	        _, probas = nnet.forward(features)
291	        predicted_labels = np.argmax(probas, axis=1)
292	
293	        onehot_targets = int_to_onehot(targets, num_labels=num_labels)
294	        loss = np.mean((onehot_targets - probas)**2)
295	        correct_pred += (predicted_labels == targets).sum()
296	
297	        num_examples += targets.shape[0]
298	        mse += loss
299	
300	    mse = mse/(i+1)
301	    acc = correct_pred/num_examples
302	    return mse, acc
303	```
304	
305	逐行要点：
306	
307	- 第 2 行：评估同样调用 `minibatch_generator`，因此评估集也会被随机洗牌——但评估只有 forward、没有参数更新，累计求和与顺序无关，洗牌不影响结果。
308	- 第 6 行：`enumerate` 拿到批号 `i`，循环结束时 `i + 1` 恰好是批数（验证集 5000/100 = 50 批）。
309	- 第 8 行：`forward` 返回 `(a_h, a_out)`，用 `_` 丢弃隐藏层激活——评估不需要它。
310	- 第 16-17 行：MSE 用「批均值之和 ÷ 批数」，准确率用「累计对题数 ÷ 总样本数」，两条口径并行走完。

312	仓库用它在未训练模型上再次测量（[ch11/ch11.py:L385-L387](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/ch11.py#L385-L387)），输出应与 4.2 的整批版一致——这本身就是一次「分批 = 整批」的交叉验证。

372	### 4.4 backward：链式法则四组梯度的 numpy 推导
373	
374	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
375	
376	`backward` 回答一个问题：**损失 L 对全部四组参数（`weight_out`、`bias_out`、`weight_h`、`bias_h`）各自的梯度是什么？**
377	
378	多维复合函数求偏导靠链式法则。以输出层权重为例，从损失到权重隔着三层复合：
379	
380	\[
381	\frac{\partial L}{\partial W^{out}}
382	= \underbrace{\frac{\partial L}{\partial A^{out}}}_{\text{损失→输出激活}}
383	\odot \underbrace{\frac{\partial A^{out}}{\partial Z^{out}}}_{\text{激活→净输入}}
384	\cdot \underbrace{\frac{\partial Z^{out}}{\partial W^{out}}}_{\text{净输入→权重}}
385	\]
386	
387	反向传播的精髓在于：**把前两个因子的乘积打包成 delta（误差信号），让它沿网络反向流动**。输出层的 `delta_out` 一方面直接组合出输出层梯度，另一方面穿过 `weight_out` 传回隐藏层、再乘上隐藏层的激活导数得到 `delta_h`，进而组合出隐藏层梯度。同一份误差信号被复用两次——这就是「反向传播」比「对每个参数独立数值求导」高效得多的原因。
388	
389	对照前向传播（u11-l1）的记号：批量输入 \(X\) 形状 \((n, 784)\)，隐藏激活 \(A^h\) 为 \((n, 50)\)，输出激活 \(A^{out}\) 为 \((n, 10)\)，独热目标 \(Y\) 为 \((n, 10)\)，损失取批内平均 MSE：
390	
391	\[
392	L = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\sum_{j=1}^{C}\left(a^{out}_{ij} - y_{ij}\right)^2
393	\]
394	
395	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
396	
397	```text
398	backward(x, a_h, a_out, y):
399	    y_onehot = int_to_onehot(y)                    # (n, 10)
400	
401	    ── Part 1：输出层 ─────────────────────────────
402	    d_loss__d_a_out  = 2*(a_out - y_onehot)/n      # (n,10)  ∂L/∂A_out
403	    d_a_out__d_z_out = a_out*(1-a_out)             # (n,10)  sigmoid 导数
404	    delta_out        = 两者逐元素相乘               # (n,10)  误差信号
405	    d_z_out__dw_out  = a_h                          # (n,50)  ∂Z_out/∂W_out
406	    d_loss__dw_out   = delta_out.T @ a_h            # (10,50) 输出层权重梯度
407	    d_loss__db_out   = delta_out 沿样本维求和        # (10,)   输出层偏置梯度
408	
409	    ── Part 2：隐藏层 ─────────────────────────────
410	    d_z_out__a_h     = weight_out                   # (10,50) ∂Z_out/∂A_h
411	    d_loss__a_h      = delta_out @ weight_out       # (n,50)  误差传回隐藏层
412	    d_a_h__d_z_h     = a_h*(1-a_h)                  # (n,50)  sigmoid 导数
413	    d_z_h__d_w_h     = x                            # (n,784) ∂Z_h/∂W_h
414	    d_loss__d_w_h    = (d_loss__a_h ⊙ d_a_h__d_z_h).T @ x   # (50,784) 隐藏层权重梯度
415	    d_loss__d_b_h    = (d_loss__a_h ⊙ d_a_h__d_z_h) 沿样本维求和  # (50,)
416	
417	    return 四组梯度
418	```
419	
420	对应的数学式（矩阵形式，\(\odot\) 为逐元素乘）：
421	
422	\[
423	\Delta^{out} = \frac{2\,(A^{out} - Y)}{n} \odot A^{out}\left(1 - A^{out}\right)
424	\]
425	
426	\[
427	\frac{\partial L}{\partial W^{out}} = \Delta^{out\,\top} A^{h},
428	\qquad
429	\frac{\partial L}{\partial b^{out}} = \sum_{i}\Delta^{out}_{i,:}
430	\]
431	
432	\[
433	\frac{\partial L}{\partial A^{h}} = \Delta^{out} W^{out},
434	\qquad
435	\Delta^{h} = \left(\Delta^{out} W^{out}\right) \odot A^{h}\left(1 - A^{h}\right)
436	\]
437	
438	\[
439	\frac{\partial L}{\partial W^{h}} = \Delta^{h\,\top} X,
440	\qquad
441	\frac{\partial L}{\partial b^{h}} = \sum_{i}\Delta^{h}_{i,:}
442	\]
443	
444	维度自检表（n=100, h=50, d=784, C=10）——**每一步运算前先对形状，是读懂矩阵求导最可靠的办法**：
445	
446	| 代码量 | 形状 | 含义 |
447	|---|---|---|
448	| `d_loss__d_a_out` | (100, 10) | 损失对输出激活的偏导 |
449	| `d_a_out__d_z_out` | (100, 10) | 输出层 sigmoid 导数 |
450	| `delta_out` | (100, 10) | 输出层误差信号 |
451	| `d_z_out__dw_out = a_h` | (100, 50) | 输出净输入对输出权重的偏导 |
452	| `d_loss__dw_out = delta_out.T @ a_h` | (10, 50) | ✅ 与 `weight_out` 同形 |
453	| `d_loss__db_out` | (10,) | ✅ 与 `bias_out` 同形 |
454	| `d_z_out__a_h = weight_out` | (10, 50) | 输出净输入对隐藏激活的偏导 |
455	| `d_loss__a_h = delta_out @ weight_out` | (100, 50) | (100,10)@(10,50) → 误差传回隐藏层 |
456	| `d_a_h__d_z_h` | (100, 50) | 隐藏层 sigmoid 导数 |
457	| `d_z_h__d_w_h = x` | (100, 784) | 隐藏净输入对隐藏权重的偏导 |
458	| `d_loss__d_w_h` | (50, 784) | ✅ 与 `weight_h` 同形 |
459	| `d_loss__d_b_h` | (50,) | ✅ 与 `bias_h` 同形 |

464	
465	方法签名与入口（[ch11/neuralnet.py:L54-L61](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/neuralnet.py#L54-L61)）：`backward(x, a_h, a_out, y)` 接收的正是 `forward` 刚产出的两个激活矩阵——**反向传播直接复用前向的中间结果，不需要重新计算**；第 61 行先把整数标签转独热。
466	
467	**Part 1：输出层梯度**（[ch11/neuralnet.py:L63-L85](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/neuralnet.py#L63-L85)）：
468	
469	```python
470	# Part 1: dLoss/dOutWeights
471	## = dLoss/dOutAct * dOutAct/dOutNet * dOutNet/dOutWeight
472	
473	# input/output dim: [n_examples, n_classes]
474	d_loss__d_a_out = 2.*(a_out - y_onehot) / y.shape[0]
475	
476	# input/output dim: [n_examples, n_classes]
477	d_a_out__d_z_out = a_out * (1. - a_out) # sigmoid derivative
478	
479	# output dim: [n_examples, n_classes]
480	delta_out = d_loss__d_a_out * d_a_out__d_z_out # "delta (rule) placeholder"
481	
482	# [n_examples, n_hidden]
483	d_z_out__dw_out = a_h
484	
485	# input dim: [n_classes, n_examples] dot [n_examples, n_hidden]
486	# output dim: [n_classes, n_hidden]
487	d_loss__dw_out = np.dot(delta_out.T, d_z_out__dw_out)
488	d_loss__db_out = np.sum(delta_out, axis=0)
489	```
490	
491	- L69：MSE 对 \(a_{out}\) 求导得 \(2(a_{out}-y)/n\)，减法方向是「预测 − 目标」，与「目标 − 预测」只差符号，随后更新时会再乘负号抵消。
492	- L72：sigmoid 导数 \(\sigma(z)(1-\sigma(z))\)——用激活值本身表示，无需再存 z。
493	- L75：注释里的 "delta (rule) placeholder" 点明这就是经典的 delta 规则误差项。
494	- L80：由 \(z_{out} = a_h W_{out}^\top + b_{out}\) 可知 \(\partial z_{out}/\partial W_{out}\) 就是 \(a_h\)——**权重梯度的「特征」来自下一层输入**（与 AdalineGD 中梯度 \(x\) 的角色完全一致，只是 x 换成了隐藏层激活 a_h）。
495	- L84：`delta_out.T @ a_h` 即 (10,100)@(100,50) → (10,50)，一次矩阵乘同时完成「链式相乘」与「批内求和」。
496	- L85：偏置对每个样本的净输入都有贡献，所以梯度沿样本维（axis=0）求和。
497	
498	**Part 2：隐藏层梯度**（[ch11/neuralnet.py:L88-L108](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/neuralnet.py#L88-L108)）：

500	```python
501	# Part 2: dLoss/dHiddenWeights
502	## = DeltaOut * dOutNet/dHiddenAct * dHiddenAct/dHiddenNet * dHiddenNet/dWeight
503	
504	# [n_classes, n_hidden]
505	d_z_out__a_h = self.weight_out
506	
507	# output dim: [n_examples, n_hidden]
508	d_loss__a_h = np.dot(delta_out, d_z_out__a_h)
509	
510	# [n_examples, n_hidden]
511	d_a_h__d_z_h = a_h * (1. - a_h) # sigmoid derivative
512	
513	# [n_examples, n_features]
514	d_z_h__d_w_h = x
515	
516	# output dim: [n_hidden, n_features]
517	d_loss__d_w_h = np.dot((d_loss__a_h * d_a_h__d_z_h).T, d_z_h__d_w_h)
518	d_loss__d_b_h = np.sum((d_loss__a_h * d_a_h__d_z_h), axis=0)
519	
520	return d_loss__dw_out, d_loss__db_out, d_loss__d_w_h, d_loss__d_b_h
521	```

523	- L93：由 \(z_{out} = a_h W_{out}^\top\)，得 \(\partial z_{out}/\partial a_h = W_{out}\)——**误差反向穿过的「通道」就是前向用过的权重矩阵本身**，这正是「反向传播」名字的由来。
524	- L96：`delta_out @ weight_out`，(100,10)@(10,50) → (100,50)：输出层误差信号被分配回每个隐藏单元，转置已隐含在乘法顺序中。

526	- L105：`d_loss__a_h * d_a_h__d_z_h` 即 \(\Delta^h\)，转置后与输入 x 相乘得 (50,784)，与 `weight_h` 同形，可直接做梯度下降更新。

577	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
578	
579	**练习 1**：为什么 `d_loss__db_out` 是沿 `axis=0` 求和，而 `d_loss__dw_out` 要做矩阵乘？
580	
581	答案：偏置进入每个样本的净输入 \(z_{out} = a_h W^\top + b\) 时没有乘任何输入，链式法则里 \(\partial z_{ij}/\partial b_j = 1\)，n 个样本的梯度贡献只能相加，故 `np.sum(delta_out, axis=0)`；权重则乘上了第 k 个输入（a_h 的第 k 列），「求和」与「乘输入」合并成一次矩阵乘 `delta_out.T @ a_h`。可以说偏置的梯度就是权重梯度在「输入恒为 1」时的特例。
582	
583	**练习 2**：如果把隐藏层激活换成恒等函数（不用 sigmoid），整个网络等效于什么？`d_a_h__d_z_h` 变成多少？
584	
585	答案：两层线性变换的复合仍是线性变换（u11-l1 的结论），网络退化成线性模型，无论隐藏层多宽都只能画线性决策边界。此时 \(\partial a_h/\partial z_h = 1\)，即 `d_a_h__d_z_h` 变成全 1 数组，反向传播退化为纯线性回传——这正是「非线性激活是深度的来源」的数学体现。
586	
587	**练习 3**：`d_loss__a_h = np.dot(delta_out, self.weight_out)` 中为什么不需要对 `weight_out` 转置？
588	
589	答案：由 \(z_{out} = a_h W_{out}^\top\) 得 \(\partial L/\partial a_h = \Delta^{out} W_{out}\)，形状 (n,10)@(10,50)=(n,50)；矩阵乘法本身的顺序（delta 在左、W 在右）已经完成了所需的「转置」，再显式转置反而维度不对。对比 Part 1 的 `delta_out.T @ a_h`：那里需要 (C,n)@(n,H)，故对 delta 转置——两边遵循的其实是同一个维度自检原则。

593	### 4.5 train 函数：把一切组装成 minibatch 训练循环
594	
595	#### 4.5.1 概念说明
596	
597	至此零件齐备：`minibatch_generator` 供数据、`forward` 算激活、`backward` 算梯度、`compute_mse_and_acc` 做测量。`train` 函数按「**逐 epoch → 逐 batch：前向 → 反向 → 更新 → epoch 末测量记录**」的骨架把它们串成完整的 mini-batch SGD 循环——这就是全书第一个（也是唯一一个）从零手写的神经网络训练器，结构上与 u2-l3 的 AdalineSGD「按轮-逐样本」双层循环完全同构，只是更新粒度从 1 个样本变成 100 个样本、梯度来源从解析单层公式变成反向传播。
598	
599	#### 4.5.2 核心流程
600	
601	```text
602	train(model, X_train, y_train, X_valid, y_valid, num_epochs, lr=0.1):
603	    记录表: epoch_loss / epoch_train_acc / epoch_valid_acc
604	    for e in 1..num_epochs:                     # 每个 epoch
605	        for (X_mini, y_mini) in minibatch_generator(X_train, y_train, 100):
606	            a_h, a_out = model.forward(X_mini)             # ① 前向
607	            四组梯度 = model.backward(X_mini, a_h, a_out, y_mini)  # ② 反向
608	            model.weight_h  -= lr * d_loss__d_w_h           # ③ 梯度下降
609	            model.bias_h    -= lr * d_loss__d_b_h           #    （减号 = 负梯度方向）
610	            model.weight_out -= lr * d_loss__d_w_out
611	            model.bias_out   -= lr * d_loss__d_b_out
612	        train_mse, train_acc = compute_mse_and_acc(model, X_train, y_train)  # ④ 测量
613	        valid_mse, valid_acc = compute_mse_and_acc(model, X_valid, y_valid)
614	        记录并打印一行日志
615	    return epoch_loss, epoch_train_acc, epoch_valid_acc
616	```
617	
618	注意 ③ 中四组参数共用同一个学习率 0.1，更新发生在**每个 batch 之后**（一个 epoch 更新 550 次），而不是每个 epoch 之后——这是 SGD 与整批 GD（u2-l2）最本质的区别。

625	def train(model, X_train, y_train, X_valid, y_valid, num_epochs,
626	          learning_rate=0.1):
627	
628	    epoch_loss = []
629	    epoch_train_acc = []
630	    epoch_valid_acc = []
631	
632	    for e in range(num_epochs):
633

637

639

641	            a_h, a_out = model.forward(X_train_mini)
642	
643	            #### Compute gradients ####
644	            d_loss__d_w_out, d_loss__d_b_out, d_loss__d_w_h, d_loss__d_b_h =                 model.backward(X_train_mini, a_h, a_out, y_train_mini)
645	
646	            #### Update weights ####
647	            model.weight_h -= learning_rate * d_loss__d_w_h
648	            model.bias_h -= learning_rate * d_loss__d_b_h
649	            model.weight_out -= learning_rate * d_loss__d_w_out
650	            model.bias_out -= learning_rate * d_loss__d_b_out
651	
652	        #### Epoch Logging ####
653	        train_mse, train_acc = compute_mse_and_acc(model, X_train, y_train)
654	        valid_mse, valid_acc = compute_mse_and_acc(model, X_valid, y_valid)
655	        train_acc, valid_acc = train_acc*100, valid_acc*100
656	        epoch_train_acc.append(train_acc)
657	        epoch_valid_acc.append(valid_acc)
658	        epoch_loss.append(train_mse)
659	        print(f'Epoch: {e+1:03d}/{num_epochs:03d} '
660	              f'| Train MSE: {train_mse:.2f} '
661	              f'| Train Acc: {train_acc:.2f}% '
662	              f'| Valid Acc: {valid_acc:.2f}%')

713	
714	#### 4.5.5 小练习与答案
715	
716	**练习 1**：`train` 中权重更新发生在每一批之后还是每个 epoch 之后？这对应哪种梯度下降？

718	答案：每个 batch（100 个样本）之后立即更新，一个 epoch 更新 550 次。这是 mini-batch SGD——u2-l3 AdalineSGD 的「逐样本」版把 batch 换成 1，u2-l2 AdalineGD 的「整批」版把 batch 换成全部样本。
719	
720	**练习 2**：`epoch_loss` 里记录的是哪个集合的 MSE？`valid_mse` 去哪了？
721	
722	答案：训练集的 MSE（L420 的 `train_mse`）。`valid_mse` 在 L421 计算出来后没有被记录或使用，属于「算了但没存」的死值——若想画验证 MSE 曲线，需要自行增加一张 `epoch_valid_loss` 列表并在循环里 append。

724	**练习 3**：为什么 `train` 函数不返回 `model`，训练效果却能保留下来？
725	
726	答案：Python 的参数传递是「传对象引用」，`model` 是可变对象，函数内 `model.weight_h -= ...` 等语句原地修改了对象的属性；调用方持有的引用与函数内是同一个对象，修改直接可见。返回值只用于带回三张记录表。

730	## 5. 综合实践
731	
732	**任务：隐藏层宽度扫描实验——把 50 改成 [10, 50, 100]，量化「宽度 vs 精度 vs 耗时」。**
733	
734	本实验贯穿本讲全部内容：`minibatch_generator` 切批、`forward`/`backward` 前向反向、`compute_mse_and_acc` 测量、`train` 循环组装，再加上 `time.perf_counter` 计时。
735	
736	先做预测（学会先猜再验）：参数量 ≈ \(784h + h + 10h + 10\)，h=10/50/100 分别约 **0.8 万 / 4.0 万 / 8.0 万**。据此猜测：每轮耗时大致随 h 线性增长；h=10 容量不足、最终准确率明显偏低；h=50 与 h=100 差距应小于 h=10 与 h=50 的差距（容量收益递减）。
737	
738	操作步骤：在 `ch11` 目录下新建 `width_experiment.py`（示例代码，新建文件、不改动任何原源码；待本地验证）：
739	
740	```python
741	# width_experiment.py —— 隐藏层宽度对比实验
742	# 运行：cd ch11 && python width_experiment.py
743	import time
744	import numpy as np
745	import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
746	from sklearn.datasets import fetch_openml
747	from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
748	from neuralnet import NeuralNetMLP, int_to_onehot
749	
750	# ---------- 数据准备（与 ch11.py L107-L167 相同） ----------
751	X, y = fetch_openml('mnist_784', version=1, return_X_y=True)
752	X = ((X.values / 255.) - .5) * 2
753	y = y.astype(int).values
754	X_temp, X_test, y_temp, y_test = train_test_split(
755	    X, y, test_size=10000, random_state=123, stratify=y)
756	X_train, X_valid, y_train, y_valid = train_test_split(
757	    X_temp, y_temp, test_size=5000, random_state=123, stratify=y_temp)
758	
759	# ---------- 训练组件（与 ch11.py 同名实现一致，增加计时） ----------
760	def minibatch_generator(X, y, minibatch_size):
761	    indices = np.arange(X.shape[0])
762	    np.random.shuffle(indices)
763	    for start_idx in range(0, indices.shape[0] - minibatch_size
764	                           + 1, minibatch_size):
765	        batch_idx = indices[start_idx:start_idx + minibatch_size]
766	        yield X[batch_idx], y[batch_idx]
767	
768	def compute_mse_and_acc(nnet, X, y, num_labels=10, minibatch_size=100):
769	    mse, correct_pred, num_examples = 0., 0, 0
770	    minibatch_gen = minibatch_generator(X, y, minibatch_size)
771	    for i, (features, targets) in enumerate(minibatch_gen):
772	        _, probas = nnet.forward(features)
773	        predicted_labels = np.argmax(probas, axis=1)
774	        onehot_targets = int_to_onehot(targets, num_labels=num_labels)
775	        mse += np.mean((onehot_targets - probas)**2)
776	        correct_pred += (predicted_labels == targets).sum()
777	        num_examples += targets.shape[0]
778	    return mse/(i+1), correct_pred/num_examples
779	
780	def train(model, X_train, y_train, X_valid, y_valid, num_epochs,
781	          learning_rate=0.1, minibatch_size=100):
782	    epoch_loss, epoch_tr, epoch_va, epoch_secs = [], [], [], []
783	    for e in range(num_epochs):
784	        t0 = time.perf_counter()
785	        for X_mini, y_mini in minibatch_generator(
786	                X_train, y_train, minibatch_size):
787	            a_h, a_out = model.forward(X_mini)
788	            d_w_out, d_b_out, d_w_h, d_b_h = model.backward(
789	                X_mini, a_h, a_out, y_mini)
790	            model.weight_h -= learning_rate * d_w_h
791	            model.bias_h -= learning_rate * d_b_h
792	            model.weight_out -= learning_rate * d_w_out
793	            model.bias_out -= learning_rate * d_b_out
794	        secs = time.perf_counter() - t0
795	        train_mse, train_acc = compute_mse_and_acc(model, X_train, y_train)
796	        _, valid_acc = compute_mse_and_acc(model, X_valid, y_valid)
797	        epoch_loss.append(train_mse)
798	        epoch_tr.append(train_acc*100)
799	        epoch_va.append(valid_acc*100)
800	        epoch_secs.append(secs)
801	        print(f'h={model.weight_h.shape[0]:3d} | epoch {e+1:02d}/{num_epochs} '
802	              f'| {secs:5.1f}s | Train {train_acc*100:5.2f}% '
803	              f'| Valid {valid_acc*100:5.2f}%')
804	    return epoch_loss, epoch_tr, epoch_va, epoch_secs
805	
806	# ---------- 实验主体：h ∈ {10, 50, 100} ----------
807	results = {}
808	for num_hidden in [10, 50, 100]:
809	    np.random.seed(123)                 # 固定切批顺序，保证三组可比
810	    model = NeuralNetMLP(num_features=28*28,
811	                         num_hidden=num_hidden, num_classes=10)
812	    results[num_hidden] = train(model, X_train, y_train, X_valid,
813	                                y_valid, num_epochs=50)
814	
815	# ---------- 可视化 ----------
816	fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4))
817	for h in [10, 50, 100]:
818	    _, tr, va, secs = results[h]
819	    ax[0].plot(tr, label=f'train h={h}')
820	    ax[0].plot(va, '--', label=f'valid h={h}')

822	ax[0].set_xlabel('Epoch'); ax[0].set_ylabel('Accuracy (%)')
823	ax[0].legend(loc='lower right')
824	ax[1].set_ylabel('平均每轮耗时 (s)')

827	print('图已保存到 ch11/width_experiment.png')

829	
830	需要观察的现象与预期结果（精确数值均待本地验证）：
831	
832	1. **准确率曲线**：h=10 的训练/验证曲线明显更低且更早饱和（容量瓶颈）；h=50 与 h=100 曲线接近，后者可能略高或基本持平——宽度收益递减。
833	2. **训练/验证间距**：三组模型的训练与验证曲线间隙都不大，说明在本任务规模下未出现明显过拟合；h=100 的间隙通常略大于 h=10（容量越大越有过拟合倾向）。
834	3. **耗时**：每轮耗时应大致随 h 线性增长（矩阵乘的计算量近似正比于参数量）；h=100 的每轮耗时应约是 h=10 的 8~10 倍量级、h=50 的约 2 倍。
835	4. **复现性**：三组实验都在 `np.random.seed(123)` 之后开始，切批顺序一致；又因 `NeuralNetMLP(random_seed=123)` 固定了初始权重，重复运行应得到相同曲线。
836	
837	实验后的分析建议：把「最终验证准确率」和「平均每轮耗时」对 h 画散点，回答——为把准确率再抬 1 个百分点，多花的计算时间是否值得？这就是模型选型时最朴素的收益/成本权衡。
838	
839	## 6. 本讲小结
840	
841	- `minibatch_generator` 用「打乱下标 + `range(0, n-m+1, m)` 切批 + `yield` 惰性产出」实现数据阀门：每个 epoch 重新洗牌、只产出完整批、内存峰值只与批大小相关（55000 样本 ÷ 100 = 550 批/epoch）。
842	- `mse_loss`（可导，是 backward 的求导对象）与 `accuracy`（不可导，只做评估）分工明确；初始未训练模型的 MSE 应接近 0.25、准确率接近 10%，这是可以笔算出来的基线。
843	- `compute_mse_and_acc` 复用切批器对大数组做分批评估：一次 forward 同时算 MSE 与数对错；其 MSE 是「批均值的平均」，等批大小时才严格等于整体 MSE。
844	- `backward` 是链式法则的矩阵版：`delta_out = 2(a_out−y)/n ⊙ a_out(1−a_out)` 组合出输出层梯度后，经 `delta_out @ weight_out` 把误差传回隐藏层得到 `delta_h`，再分别与 `a_h`、`x` 相乘得到两组权重梯度、沿样本维求和得到两组偏置梯度；误差信号被复用、前向激活被复用，是「反向传播」得名的由来。
845	- `train` 把上述零件组装成 mini-batch SGD：逐批「forward → backward → 四组参数同时 `-= lr*梯度`」，epoch 末测量记录；`np.random.seed(123)` 固定切批顺序保证可复现。
846	- 数值梯度检验（中心差分 vs 解析梯度）是验证手写 backward 的标准手段；注意 `backward` 的损失约定除以 n 而非 n×C，相差常数倍 C，会被学习率吸收。
847	
848	## 7. 下一步学习建议
849	
850	本讲结束，你已经完整拥有一个「纯 numpy 的两层神经网络 + 训练器」。它暴露了三个痛点，恰好是下一单元（第 12 章，PyTorch 入门）逐一解决的：
851	
852	1. **手写梯度太苦**：`backward` 的每一行矩阵运算都要自己推导、自己检验。PyTorch 的 autograd 只需写 `loss.backward()`（u12-l3），四组梯度自动填进 `.grad`。
853	2. **权重散落各处**：`weight_h`、`bias_h`…是裸 numpy 数组，更新要逐个写。`nn.Module`（u12-l3）把参数收编成 `parameters()`，优化器一步更新全部。
854	3. **数据管线手搓**：`minibatch_generator` 只会切批。`Dataset` + `DataLoader`（u12-l2）提供 shuffle、多进程加载、图像目录数据集等成套设施。
855	
856	建议按顺序学习 u12-l1（张量基础）→ u12-l2（Dataset/DataLoader）→ u12-l3（nn.Module 与 autograd 下的 XOR 实验）。届时可以回头把本讲的 MNIST 实验用 PyTorch 重写，对比两种实现的代码量与训练速度，这个对比本身就是最好的复习。

# u11-l2 反向传播与 minibatch 训练循环

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u11-l1）我们读懂了 `NeuralNetMLP` 的前向传播：数据沿 `(n, 784) → (n, 50) → (n, 10)` 一路变换，得到每张手写数字图片的类别「打分」。但一个只会打分、不会学习的网络毫无用处——本讲解决「网络如何学习」。

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 逐行读懂 `backward` 方法：从 `d_loss__d_a_out` 出发，用链式法则推出输出层权重/偏置、隐藏层权重/偏置共四组梯度的矩阵运算，并能对每个中间数组说出形状与含义。
2. 理解 `minibatch_generator` 的「洗牌索引 + 切批 + yield」惰性流程，知道它为什么每个 epoch 都要重新洗牌。
3. 掌握 `mse_loss`、`accuracy`、`compute_mse_and_acc` 三个评估组件的分工。
4. 读懂 `train` 函数如何把前向、反向、梯度更新、逐 epoch 日志组装成完整的 mini-batch SGD 训练循环，并复现训练/验证准确率曲线。
5. 通过实践回答：把隐藏层从 50 个单元改成 10 / 50 / 100，精度和每轮耗时会怎样变化？

## 2. 前置知识

本讲站在两块基石上，请先确认你已经掌握：

- **（来自 u2-l2）梯度下降与链式求导**：AdalineGD 中我们用 \( w \leftarrow w - \eta \nabla L \) 沿负梯度方向更新权重；代价函数对权重的梯度靠链式法则逐层展开。本讲的 `backward` 就是同一件事的「两层网络 + 矩阵版」。
- **（来自 u2-l3）随机梯度下降与洗牌**：逐样本（或小批量）更新比整批更新收敛更快但曲线更抖；每轮训练前先 `shuffle` 打乱顺序，防止有序数据让更新方向周期性摆动。
- **（来自 u11-l1）前向传播的记号**：权重按「行 = 目标单元、列 = 来源特征」存放，`weight_h` 形状 `(50, 784)`、`weight_out` 形状 `(10, 50)`；`forward` 里用 `.T` 转置使维度相消；sigmoid 光滑可导，导数为 \( \sigma'(z) = \sigma(z)(1-\sigma(z)) \)；独热编码让标签与输出同形，MSE 才能逐元素计算。

几个本讲新引入的术语：

| 术语 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| epoch（轮） | 把训练集完整过一遍 |
| iteration（迭代/步） | 处理一个 minibatch 并更新一次权重；55000 个样本、batch=100 时 1 epoch = 550 次迭代 |
| minibatch（小批量） | 介于整批 GD 与逐样本 SGD 之间的折中：梯度是该批上的平均，比单样本噪声小，比整批更新频繁 |
| delta（误差信号） | 某层「损失对该层净输入」的梯度，反向传播中被逐层复用 |
| 双下划线命名 | `d_loss__d_a_out` 中的 `__` 表示「对……的偏导」，即 \( \partial L / \partial a_{out} \) |

数据准备沿用 u11-l1 交代过的流程：`fetch_openml` 取回 70000 张 28×28 灰度图（[ch11/ch11.py:L107-L109](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/ch11.py#L107-L109)），像素缩放到 \([-1, 1]\)（[ch11/ch11.py:L119](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/ch11.py#L119)），再两次 `train_test_split` 切成 55000 训练 / 5000 验证 / 10000 测试（[ch11/ch11.py:L163-L167](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/ch11.py#L163-L167)）。本讲聚焦训练机制，不再展开。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| [ch11/neuralnet.py](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/neuralnet.py) | 可 `import` 的模型模块：`sigmoid`、`int_to_onehot`、`NeuralNetMLP` | `backward` 方法（L54-L108） |

| ch11/ch11.ipynb | 上述脚本的 notebook 源 | 交互实验用 |

注意一个仓库事实：`NeuralNetMLP` 类在两个文件里各有一份完全相同的拷贝——`neuralnet.py` 是干净的模块版（L21-L108），`ch11.py` 内嵌了一份（[ch11/ch11.py:L200-L288](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/ch11.py#L200-L288)），后者让 notebook 不依赖 import 也能自包含运行。本讲精读 `backward` 时引用 `neuralnet.py` 的行号（更短、更干净）；讲训练循环时引用 `ch11.py`。两份代码逻辑一致。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

本讲四个最小模块 + 一个组装模块：

1. `minibatch_generator`：shuffle 与切批
2. `mse_loss` 与 `accuracy`：两个评估原语
3. `compute_mse_and_acc`：大数组的分批评估
4. `backward`：链式法则四组梯度的 numpy 推导
5. `train` 函数：把一切组装成 minibatch 训练循环

---

### 4.1 minibatch_generator：shuffle 与切批

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

梯度下降有三个档位：整批 GD（每轮全量数据算一次梯度，u2-l2 的 AdalineGD）、逐样本 SGD（每个样本更新一次，u2-l3 的 AdalineSGD）、以及介于两者之间的 **mini-batch SGD**——每次用一小批（本书取 100 个）样本的平均梯度更新一次权重。

为什么选 minibatch？三个理由：

1. **计算效率**：一次 `np.dot` 处理 100 个样本比循环 100 次单样本快得多（矩阵运算向量化）。
2. **梯度质量**：批内平均让梯度比单样本更稳定，噪声适中还能帮助跳出局部结构。
3. **内存友好**：配合生成器（`yield`），任何时刻内存里只有一个 batch，而不是把切好的 550 个 batch 全部存下来。

`minibatch_generator` 就是这个「每轮洗牌、逐批吐出」的数据阀门。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
minibatch_generator(X, y, minibatch_size):
    indices = [0, 1, ..., n-1]          # 样本下标
    shuffle(indices)                    # 原地打乱下标（不动数据本身）
    for start in range(0, n - m + 1, m):  # 不足一个完整批的尾部被丢弃
        batch_idx = indices[start : start + m]
        yield X[batch_idx], y[batch_idx]   # 惰性产出，用一批算一批
```

关键设计点：

- **打乱的是索引而不是数据**。`X` 有 55000×784 个浮点数，复制洗牌代价大；打乱 `(55000,)` 的下标数组等价且几乎零成本。`X[batch_idx]` 用花式索引一次性取出该批样本（产生副本），且 X、y 用同一批索引，特征与标签始终行对齐。
- **`n - m + 1` 作为 range 上界**：保证每个 batch 都是完整的 m 个样本。若样本数不是 m 的整数倍，尾部不足 m 的残余会被直接丢弃（55000 = 550×100 恰好整除，本书场景无残余）。
- **每个 epoch 重新调用一次**：`train` 里每轮都新建一个生成器，即每轮重新洗牌。这与 u2-l3 AdalineSGD 的逐轮洗牌同源——相邻 epoch 的批组成不同，避免更新方向出现周期性。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

数据装载与切批参数定义（[ch11/ch11.py:L305-L306](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/ch11.py#L305-L306)）：书中设定 `num_epochs = 50`、`minibatch_size = 100`。

### 4.2 mse_loss 与 accuracy：两个评估原语

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

训练需要两个「裁判」回答不同的问题：

- **`mse_loss`：网络拟合得好不好？** 它把 one-hot 目标与输出概率逐元素求平方差的均值。MSE 光滑可导，是 `backward` 里求导的对象——它既是「评估指标」，更是「被优化的损失函数」。
- **`accuracy`：分类分对了多少？** 它把输出矩阵每行取 `argmax` 得到预测类别，再与真实标签比对求均值。准确率不可导（有阶跃），只用于评估、不用于求梯度。

两个量不必同调：MSE 变小时准确率通常升高，但 MSE 相同的两个模型准确率可能不同。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
mse_loss(targets, probas):
    onehot = int_to_onehot(targets)        # (n,) 整数标签 → (n, 10) 独热
    return mean((onehot - probas)^2)       # 标量：所有元素平方差的平均

accuracy(targets, predicted_labels):
    return mean(predicted_labels == targets)   # 预测对的比例
```

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

两个函数本体（[ch11/ch11.py:L341-L347](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/ch11.py#L341-L347)）：

```python
def mse_loss(targets, probas, num_labels=10):
    onehot_targets = int_to_onehot(targets, num_labels=num_labels)
    return np.mean((onehot_targets - probas)**2)

def accuracy(targets, predicted_labels):
    return np.mean(predicted_labels == targets)
```

- `mse_loss` 内部复用了 u11-l1 讲过的 `int_to_onehot`：独热矩阵与 `probas` 同形 `(n, 10)`，减法逐元素合法。
- `accuracy` 只有归一化的「对/错」布尔均值，输入必须是**已经 argmax 过的类别**，不是概率矩阵。

仓库随后在**未训练**的模型上做了一次基线测量（[ch11/ch11.py:L350-L357](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/ch11.py#L350-L357)）：对整个验证集 `forward` 一次，算出初始 MSE 与准确率。我们可以先笔算预期值——初始权重是标准差 0.1 的小随机数、偏置为 0，净输入接近 0，`sigmoid(≈0) ≈ 0.5`，于是每个输出元素都在 0.5 附近；对独热目标而言，无论该元素目标是 1 还是 0，\((0.5 - y)^2 \approx 0.25\)。所以：

- 初始 MSE 应接近 **0.25**；
- 每行概率几乎相同，`argmax` 近似随机猜，十类准确率应接近 **10%**。

### 4.3 compute_mse_and_acc：大数组的分批评估

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

`mse_loss(y_valid, probas)` 这条路要求先把**整个**验证集 forward 成 `(5000, 10)` 的概率矩阵——对本例尚可承受，但对 55000 条训练集（以及更大的真实数据）会一次性产生大中间数组。`compute_mse_and_acc` 的做法是：**复用 `minibatch_generator` 把评估集也切成批，逐批 forward、逐批累计**，内存峰值只与 batch 大小相关。

它同时把 MSE 与准确率的计算合二为一：一次 forward 的结果既算损失又数对错，避免重复前向。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
compute_mse_and_acc(nnet, X, y):
    mse = 0; correct = 0; num_examples = 0
    for (features, targets) in minibatch_generator(X, y, 100):
        probas = nnet.forward(features)          # (m, 10)
        pred = argmax(probas, axis=1)
        mse += mean((onehot(targets) - probas)^2)   # 累计的是「批均值」
        correct += sum(pred == targets)
        num_examples += m
    return mse / 批数, correct / num_examples
```

一个值得注意的细节：返回的 MSE 是**各批均值的平均**（`mse/(i+1)`，`i+1` 即批数）。只有当各批大小相等时它才严格等于全体样本的 MSE；本书中 55000 与 5000 都被 100 整除，因此没有偏差。准确率则不受影响——分子分母都按样本数加权，天然正确。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

函数本体（[ch11/ch11.py:L362-L380](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/ch11.py#L362-L380)）：

```python
def compute_mse_and_acc(nnet, X, y, num_labels=10, minibatch_size=100):
    mse, correct_pred, num_examples = 0., 0, 0
    minibatch_gen = minibatch_generator(X, y, minibatch_size)

    for i, (features, targets) in enumerate(minibatch_gen):

        _, probas = nnet.forward(features)
        predicted_labels = np.argmax(probas, axis=1)

        onehot_targets = int_to_onehot(targets, num_labels=num_labels)
        loss = np.mean((onehot_targets - probas)**2)
        correct_pred += (predicted_labels == targets).sum()

        num_examples += targets.shape[0]
        mse += loss

    mse = mse/(i+1)
    acc = correct_pred/num_examples
    return mse, acc
```

逐行要点：

- 第 2 行：评估同样调用 `minibatch_generator`，因此评估集也会被随机洗牌——但评估只有 forward、没有参数更新，累计求和与顺序无关，洗牌不影响结果。
- 第 6 行：`enumerate` 拿到批号 `i`，循环结束时 `i + 1` 恰好是批数（验证集 5000/100 = 50 批）。
- 第 8 行：`forward` 返回 `(a_h, a_out)`，用 `_` 丢弃隐藏层激活——评估不需要它。
- 第 16-17 行：MSE 用「批均值之和 ÷ 批数」，准确率用「累计对题数 ÷ 总样本数」，两条口径并行走完。

仓库用它在未训练模型上再次测量（[ch11/ch11.py:L385-L387](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/ch11.py#L385-L387)），输出应与 4.2 的整批版一致——这本身就是一次「分批 = 整批」的交叉验证。

### 4.4 backward：链式法则四组梯度的 numpy 推导

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

`backward` 回答一个问题：**损失 L 对全部四组参数（`weight_out`、`bias_out`、`weight_h`、`bias_h`）各自的梯度是什么？**

多维复合函数求偏导靠链式法则。以输出层权重为例，从损失到权重隔着三层复合：

\[
\frac{\partial L}{\partial W^{out}}
= \underbrace{\frac{\partial L}{\partial A^{out}}}_{\text{损失→输出激活}}
\odot \underbrace{\frac{\partial A^{out}}{\partial Z^{out}}}_{\text{激活→净输入}}
\cdot \underbrace{\frac{\partial Z^{out}}{\partial W^{out}}}_{\text{净输入→权重}}
\]

反向传播的精髓在于：**把前两个因子的乘积打包成 delta（误差信号），让它沿网络反向流动**。输出层的 `delta_out` 一方面直接组合出输出层梯度，另一方面穿过 `weight_out` 传回隐藏层、再乘上隐藏层的激活导数得到 `delta_h`，进而组合出隐藏层梯度。同一份误差信号被复用两次——这就是「反向传播」比「对每个参数独立数值求导」高效得多的原因。

对照前向传播（u11-l1）的记号：批量输入 \(X\) 形状 \((n, 784)\)，隐藏激活 \(A^h\) 为 \((n, 50)\)，输出激活 \(A^{out}\) 为 \((n, 10)\)，独热目标 \(Y\) 为 \((n, 10)\)，损失取批内平均 MSE：

\[
L = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\sum_{j=1}^{C}\left(a^{out}_{ij} - y_{ij}\right)^2
\]

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
backward(x, a_h, a_out, y):
    y_onehot = int_to_onehot(y)                    # (n, 10)

    ── Part 1：输出层 ─────────────────────────────
    d_loss__d_a_out  = 2*(a_out - y_onehot)/n      # (n,10)  ∂L/∂A_out
    d_a_out__d_z_out = a_out*(1-a_out)             # (n,10)  sigmoid 导数
    delta_out        = 两者逐元素相乘               # (n,10)  误差信号
    d_z_out__dw_out  = a_h                          # (n,50)  ∂Z_out/∂W_out
    d_loss__dw_out   = delta_out.T @ a_h            # (10,50) 输出层权重梯度
    d_loss__db_out   = delta_out 沿样本维求和        # (10,)   输出层偏置梯度

    ── Part 2：隐藏层 ─────────────────────────────
    d_z_out__a_h     = weight_out                   # (10,50) ∂Z_out/∂A_h
    d_loss__a_h      = delta_out @ weight_out       # (n,50)  误差传回隐藏层
    d_a_h__d_z_h     = a_h*(1-a_h)                  # (n,50)  sigmoid 导数
    d_z_h__d_w_h     = x                            # (n,784) ∂Z_h/∂W_h
    d_loss__d_w_h    = (d_loss__a_h ⊙ d_a_h__d_z_h).T @ x   # (50,784) 隐藏层权重梯度
    d_loss__d_b_h    = (d_loss__a_h ⊙ d_a_h__d_z_h) 沿样本维求和  # (50,)

    return 四组梯度
```

对应的数学式（矩阵形式，\(\odot\) 为逐元素乘）：

\[
\Delta^{out} = \frac{2\,(A^{out} - Y)}{n} \odot A^{out}\left(1 - A^{out}\right)
\]

\[
\frac{\partial L}{\partial W^{out}} = \Delta^{out\,\top} A^{h},
\qquad
\frac{\partial L}{\partial b^{out}} = \sum_{i}\Delta^{out}_{i,:}
\]

\[
\frac{\partial L}{\partial A^{h}} = \Delta^{out} W^{out},
\qquad
\Delta^{h} = \left(\Delta^{out} W^{out}\right) \odot A^{h}\left(1 - A^{h}\right)
\]

\[
\frac{\partial L}{\partial W^{h}} = \Delta^{h\,\top} X,
\qquad
\frac{\partial L}{\partial b^{h}} = \sum_{i}\Delta^{h}_{i,:}
\]

维度自检表（n=100, h=50, d=784, C=10）——**每一步运算前先对形状，是读懂矩阵求导最可靠的办法**：

| 代码量 | 形状 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `d_loss__d_a_out` | (100, 10) | 损失对输出激活的偏导 |
| `d_a_out__d_z_out` | (100, 10) | 输出层 sigmoid 导数 |
| `delta_out` | (100, 10) | 输出层误差信号 |
| `d_z_out__dw_out = a_h` | (100, 50) | 输出净输入对输出权重的偏导 |
| `d_loss__dw_out = delta_out.T @ a_h` | (10, 50) | ✅ 与 `weight_out` 同形 |
| `d_loss__db_out` | (10,) | ✅ 与 `bias_out` 同形 |
| `d_z_out__a_h = weight_out` | (10, 50) | 输出净输入对隐藏激活的偏导 |
| `d_loss__a_h = delta_out @ weight_out` | (100, 50) | (100,10)@(10,50) → 误差传回隐藏层 |
| `d_a_h__d_z_h` | (100, 50) | 隐藏层 sigmoid 导数 |
| `d_z_h__d_w_h = x` | (100, 784) | 隐藏净输入对隐藏权重的偏导 |

| `d_loss__d_b_h` | (50,) | ✅ 与 `bias_h` 同形 |

一个容易被忽略的尺度细节：`backward` 里的 `d_loss__d_a_out` 除以的是样本数 \(n\)（`y.shape[0]`），而 4.2 的 `mse_loss` 对**全部 \(n \times C\) 个元素**取均值——两者相差常数倍 \(C=10\)。常数因子会被学习率吸收（相当于有效步长放大 10 倍），不影响梯度方向，所以训练照常工作。但当你做 4.4.4 的数值检验时，必须让参考损失与 `backward` 采用同一约定（除以 \(n\)），否则数值梯度会正好差 10 倍。

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

方法签名与入口（[ch11/neuralnet.py:L54-L61](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/neuralnet.py#L54-L61)）：`backward(x, a_h, a_out, y)` 接收的正是 `forward` 刚产出的两个激活矩阵——**反向传播直接复用前向的中间结果，不需要重新计算**；第 61 行先把整数标签转独热。

**Part 1：输出层梯度**（[ch11/neuralnet.py:L63-L85](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/neuralnet.py#L63-L85)）：

```python
# Part 1: dLoss/dOutWeights
## = dLoss/dOutAct * dOutAct/dOutNet * dOutNet/dOutWeight

# input/output dim: [n_examples, n_classes]
d_loss__d_a_out = 2.*(a_out - y_onehot) / y.shape[0]

# input/output dim: [n_examples, n_classes]
d_a_out__d_z_out = a_out * (1. - a_out) # sigmoid derivative

# output dim: [n_examples, n_classes]
delta_out = d_loss__d_a_out * d_a_out__d_z_out # "delta (rule) placeholder"

# [n_examples, n_hidden]
d_z_out__dw_out = a_h

# input dim: [n_classes, n_examples] dot [n_examples, n_hidden]
# output dim: [n_classes, n_hidden]
d_loss__dw_out = np.dot(delta_out.T, d_z_out__dw_out)
d_loss__db_out = np.sum(delta_out, axis=0)
```

- L69：MSE 对 \(a_{out}\) 求导得 \(2(a_{out}-y)/n\)，减法方向是「预测 − 目标」，与「目标 − 预测」只差符号，随后更新时会再乘负号抵消。
- L72：sigmoid 导数 \(\sigma(z)(1-\sigma(z))\)——用激活值本身表示，无需再存 z。
- L75：注释里的 "delta (rule) placeholder" 点明这就是经典的 delta 规则误差项。
- L80：由 \(z_{out} = a_h W_{out}^\top + b_{out}\) 可知 \(\partial z_{out}/\partial W_{out}\) 就是 \(a_h\)——**权重梯度的「特征」来自下一层输入**（与 AdalineGD 中梯度 \(x\) 的角色完全一致，只是 x 换成了隐藏层激活 a_h）。
- L84：`delta_out.T @ a_h` 即 (10,100)@(100,50) → (10,50)，一次矩阵乘同时完成「链式相乘」与「批内求和」。
- L85：偏置对每个样本的净输入都有贡献，所以梯度沿样本维（axis=0）求和。

**Part 2：隐藏层梯度**（[ch11/neuralnet.py:L88-L108](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/neuralnet.py#L88-L108)）：

```python
## = DeltaOut * dOutNet/dHiddenAct * dHiddenAct/dHiddenNet * dHiddenNet/dWeight

# [n_classes, n_hidden]
d_z_out__a_h = self.weight_out

# output dim: [n_examples, n_hidden]
d_loss__a_h = np.dot(delta_out, d_z_out__a_h)

# [n_examples, n_hidden]
d_a_h__d_z_h = a_h * (1. - a_h) # sigmoid derivative

# [n_examples, n_features]
d_z_h__d_w_h = x

# output dim: [n_hidden, n_features]
d_loss__d_w_h = np.dot((d_loss__a_h * d_a_h__d_z_h).T, d_z_h__d_w_h)
d_loss__d_b_h = np.sum((d_loss__a_h * d_a_h__d_z_h), axis=0)

return d_loss__dw_out, d_loss__db_out, d_loss__d_w_h, d_loss__d_b_h
```

- L93：由 \(z_{out} = a_h W_{out}^\top\)，得 \(\partial z_{out}/\partial a_h = W_{out}\)——**误差反向穿过的「通道」就是前向用过的权重矩阵本身**，这正是「反向传播」名字的由来。
- L96：`delta_out @ weight_out`，(100,10)@(10,50) → (100,50)：输出层误差信号被分配回每个隐藏单元，转置已隐含在乘法顺序中。

- L105：`d_loss__a_h * d_a_h__d_z_h` 即 \(\Delta^h\)，转置后与输入 x 相乘得 (50,784)，与 `weight_h` 同形，可直接做梯度下降更新。
- L108：按固定顺序返回四组梯度；`train` 函数按同一顺序解包。

#### 4.4.4 代码实践：数值梯度检验

**实践目标**：用中心差分独立计算 `weight_out` 某个元素的数值梯度，验证 `backward` 的解析推导正确——这是深度学习工程里检验手写梯度的标准手段。

操作步骤（示例代码，待本地验证；在 `ch11` 目录下运行）：

```python
# grad_check.py
import numpy as np
from neuralnet import NeuralNetMLP

np.random.seed(0)
model = NeuralNetMLP(num_features=5, num_hidden=4, num_classes=3,
                     random_seed=1)

X = np.random.randn(6, 5)              # 6 个样本、5 维特征
y = np.array([0, 1, 2, 1, 0, 2])

a_h, a_out = model.forward(X)
d_w_out, d_b_out, d_w_h, d_b_h = model.backward(X, a_h, a_out, y)

# 参考损失必须与 backward 同约定：除以样本数 n（而不是 n*C）
def batch_loss(m):
    _, a = m.forward(X)
    Y = np.eye(m.num_classes)[y]
    return np.sum((Y - a) ** 2) / X.shape[0]

eps = 1e-6
i, j = 0, 0
orig = model.weight_out[i, j]

model.weight_out[i, j] = orig + eps;  loss_plus = batch_loss(model)
model.weight_out[i, j] = orig - eps;  loss_minus = batch_loss(model)
model.weight_out[i, j] = orig                      # 恢复

numeric_grad = (loss_plus - loss_minus) / (2 * eps)
print(f'解析梯度 d_loss__dw_out[0,0] = {d_w_out[i, j]:.8f}')
print(f'数值梯度(中心差分)       = {numeric_grad:.8f}')
```

需要观察的现象：

1. 两个梯度应当在前 6~7 位小数上一致（典型误差量级 1e-9~1e-10），证明链式法则实现无误。
2. 把 `i, j` 换成其他下标、或改成检验 `weight_h`、`bias_h`（改动 `d_w_h[i, j]` 对应行），同样应当对齐。
3. 把 `batch_loss` 换成 4.2 的 `mse_loss` 口径（`np.mean`，除以 \(n \times C\)），数值梯度会缩小为原来的 1/3（本例 C=3）——亲手复现 4.4.2 提到的常数因子现象。

预期结果：解析与数值梯度一致；改变损失口径后出现恰好 C 倍的差。待本地验证。

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `d_loss__db_out` 是沿 `axis=0` 求和，而 `d_loss__dw_out` 要做矩阵乘？

答案：偏置进入每个样本的净输入 \(z_{out} = a_h W^\top + b\) 时没有乘任何输入，链式法则里 \(\partial z_{ij}/\partial b_j = 1\)，n 个样本的梯度贡献只能相加，故 `np.sum(delta_out, axis=0)`；权重则乘上了第 k 个输入（a_h 的第 k 列），「求和」与「乘输入」合并成一次矩阵乘 `delta_out.T @ a_h`。可以说偏置的梯度就是权重梯度在「输入恒为 1」时的特例。

**练习 2**：如果把隐藏层激活换成恒等函数（不用 sigmoid），整个网络等效于什么？`d_a_h__d_z_h` 变成多少？

答案：两层线性变换的复合仍是线性变换（u11-l1 的结论），网络退化成线性模型，无论隐藏层多宽都只能画线性决策边界。此时 \(\partial a_h/\partial z_h = 1\)，即 `d_a_h__d_z_h` 变成全 1 数组，反向传播退化为纯线性回传——这正是「非线性激活是深度的来源」的数学体现。

**练习 3**：`d_loss__a_h = np.dot(delta_out, self.weight_out)` 中为什么不需要对 `weight_out` 转置？

答案：由 \(z_{out} = a_h W_{out}^\top\) 得 \(\partial L/\partial a_h = \Delta^{out} W_{out}\)，形状 (n,10)@(10,50)=(n,50)；矩阵乘法本身的顺序（delta 在左、W 在右）已经完成了所需的「转置」，再显式转置反而维度不对。对比 Part 1 的 `delta_out.T @ a_h`：那里需要 (C,n)@(n,H)，故对 delta 转置——两边遵循的其实是同一个维度自检原则。

### 4.5 train 函数：把一切组装成 minibatch 训练循环

#### 4.5.1 概念说明

至此零件齐备：`minibatch_generator` 供数据、`forward` 算激活、`backward` 算梯度、`compute_mse_and_acc` 做测量。`train` 函数按「**逐 epoch → 逐 batch：前向 → 反向 → 更新 → epoch 末测量记录**」的骨架把它们串成完整的 mini-batch SGD 循环——这就是全书第一个（也是唯一一个）从零手写的神经网络训练器，结构上与 u2-l3 的 AdalineSGD「按轮-逐样本」双层循环完全同构，只是更新粒度从 1 个样本变成 100 个样本、梯度来源从解析单层公式变成反向传播。

#### 4.5.2 核心流程

```text
train(model, X_train, y_train, X_valid, y_valid, num_epochs, lr=0.1):
    记录表: epoch_loss / epoch_train_acc / epoch_valid_acc
    for e in 1..num_epochs:                     # 每个 epoch
        for (X_mini, y_mini) in minibatch_generator(X_train, y_train, 100):
            a_h, a_out = model.forward(X_mini)             # ① 前向
            四组梯度 = model.backward(X_mini, a_h, a_out, y_mini)  # ② 反向
            model.weight_h  -= lr * d_loss__d_w_h           # ③ 梯度下降
            model.bias_h    -= lr * d_loss__d_b_h           #    （减号 = 负梯度方向）
            model.weight_out -= lr * d_loss__d_w_out
            model.bias_out   -= lr * d_loss__d_b_out
        train_mse, train_acc = compute_mse_and_acc(model, X_train, y_train)  # ④ 测量
        valid_mse, valid_acc = compute_mse_and_acc(model, X_valid, y_valid)
        记录并打印一行日志
    return epoch_loss, epoch_train_acc, epoch_valid_acc
```

注意 ③ 中四组参数共用同一个学习率 0.1，更新发生在**每个 batch 之后**（一个 epoch 更新 550 次），而不是每个 epoch 之后——这是 SGD 与整批 GD（u2-l2）最本质的区别。

#### 4.5.3 源码精读

函数本体（[ch11/ch11.py:L392-L431](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/ch11.py#L392-L431)）：

```python
def train(model, X_train, y_train, X_valid, y_valid, num_epochs,
          learning_rate=0.1):

    epoch_loss = []
    epoch_train_acc = []
    epoch_valid_acc = []

    for e in range(num_epochs):

        # iterate over minibatches
        minibatch_gen = minibatch_generator(
            X_train, y_train, minibatch_size)

        for X_train_mini, y_train_mini in minibatch_gen:

            #### Compute outputs ####
            a_h, a_out = model.forward(X_train_mini)

            #### Compute gradients ####
            d_loss__d_w_out, d_loss__d_b_out, d_loss__d_w_h, d_loss__d_b_h =                 model.backward(X_train_mini, a_h, a_out, y_train_mini)

            #### Update weights ####
            model.weight_h -= learning_rate * d_loss__d_w_h
            model.bias_h -= learning_rate * d_loss__d_b_h
            model.weight_out -= learning_rate * d_loss__d_w_out
            model.bias_out -= learning_rate * d_loss__d_b_out

        #### Epoch Logging ####
        train_mse, train_acc = compute_mse_and_acc(model, X_train, y_train)
        valid_mse, valid_acc = compute_mse_and_acc(model, X_valid, y_valid)
        train_acc, valid_acc = train_acc*100, valid_acc*100
        epoch_train_acc.append(train_acc)
        epoch_valid_acc.append(valid_acc)
        epoch_loss.append(train_mse)
        print(f'Epoch: {e+1:03d}/{num_epochs:03d} '
              f'| Train MSE: {train_mse:.2f} '
              f'| Train Acc: {train_acc:.2f}% '
              f'| Valid Acc: {valid_acc:.2f}%')

    return epoch_loss, epoch_train_acc, epoch_valid_acc
```

要点：

- L395-L397：三张记录表分别存训练 MSE、训练准确率、验证准确率（都按 epoch 粒度）。
- L402-L403：每个 epoch **新建**生成器——即每轮重新洗牌（呼应 4.1）。
- L408-L411：前向拿激活、反向拿梯度；`backward` 返回的四组梯度按固定顺序解包（4.4.3 的 L108）。
- L414-L417：`-= learning_rate * 梯度`。负梯度方向就是减号；更新的是模型属性本身（原地修改，`model` 是可变对象，函数无需返回模型）。
- L420-L421：注意 `train_mse` 与 `valid_mse` 都算了，但**只有训练 MSE 进了 `epoch_loss`**；验证 MSE 仅打印时丢弃（`valid_mse` 未被使用）。
- L426-L429：`{e+1:03d}` 把 epoch 编号格式化为 3 位宽度，日志对齐。

训练的启动与复现（[ch11/ch11.py:L436-L440](https://github.com/rasbt/machine-learning-book/blob/63bee951ca45420ac33ccf803ceb337afc3c0a91/ch11/ch11.py#L436-L440)）：

## 5. 综合实践

**任务：隐藏层宽度扫描实验——把 50 改成 [10, 50, 100]，量化「宽度 vs 精度 vs 耗时」。**

本实验贯穿本讲全部内容：`minibatch_generator` 切批、`forward`/`backward` 前向反向、`compute_mse_and_acc` 测量、`train` 循环组装，再加上 `time.perf_counter` 计时。

先做预测（学会先猜再验）：参数量 ≈ \(784h + h + 10h + 10\)，h=10/50/100 分别约 **0.8 万 / 4.0 万 / 8.0 万**。据此猜测：每轮耗时大致随 h 线性增长；h=10 容量不足、最终准确率明显偏低；h=50 与 h=100 差距应小于 h=10 与 h=50 的差距（容量收益递减）。

操作步骤：在 `ch11` 目录下新建 `width_experiment.py`（示例代码，新建文件、不改动任何原源码；待本地验证）：

```python
# width_experiment.py —— 隐藏层宽度对比实验
# 运行：cd ch11 && python width_experiment.py
import time
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.datasets import fetch_openml
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from neuralnet import NeuralNetMLP, int_to_onehot

# ---------- 数据准备（与 ch11.py L107-L167 相同） ----------
X, y = fetch_openml('mnist_784', version=1, return_X_y=True)
X = ((X.values / 255.) - .5) * 2
y = y.astype(int).values
X_temp, X_test, y_temp, y_test = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=10000, random_state=123, stratify=y)
X_train, X_valid, y_train, y_valid = train_test_split(
    X_temp, y_temp, test_size=5000, random_state=123, stratify=y_temp)

# ---------- 训练组件（与 ch11.py 同名实现一致，增加计时） ----------
def minibatch_generator(X, y, minibatch_size):
    indices = np.arange(X.shape[0])
    np.random.shuffle(indices)
    for start_idx in range(0, indices.shape[0] - minibatch_size
                           + 1, minibatch_size):
        batch_idx = indices[start_idx:start_idx + minibatch_size]
        yield X[batch_idx], y[batch_idx]

def compute_mse_and_acc(nnet, X, y, num_labels=10, minibatch_size=100):
    mse, correct_pred, num_examples = 0., 0, 0
    minibatch_gen = minibatch_generator(X, y, minibatch_size)
    for i, (features, targets) in enumerate(minibatch_gen):
        _, probas = nnet.forward(features)
        predicted_labels = np.argmax(probas, axis=1)
        onehot_targets = int_to_onehot(targets, num_labels=num_labels)
        mse += np.mean((onehot_targets - probas)**2)
        correct_pred += (predicted_labels == targets).sum()
        num_examples += targets.shape[0]
    return mse/(i+1), correct_pred/num_examples

def train(model, X_train, y_train, X_valid, y_valid, num_epochs,
          learning_rate=0.1, minibatch_size=100):
    epoch_loss, epoch_tr, epoch_va, epoch_secs = [], [], [], []
    for e in range(num_epochs):
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        for X_mini, y_mini in minibatch_generator(
                X_train, y_train, minibatch_size):
            a_h, a_out = model.forward(X_mini)
            d_w_out, d_b_out, d_w_h, d_b_h = model.backward(
                X_mini, a_h, a_out, y_mini)
            model.weight_h -= learning_rate * d_w_h
            model.bias_h -= learning_rate * d_b_h
            model.weight_out -= learning_rate * d_w_out
            model.bias_out -= learning_rate * d_b_out
        secs = time.perf_counter() - t0
        train_mse, train_acc = compute_mse_and_acc(model, X_train, y_train)
        _, valid_acc = compute_mse_and_acc(model, X_valid, y_valid)
        epoch_loss.append(train_mse)
        epoch_tr.append(train_acc*100)
        epoch_va.append(valid_acc*100)
        epoch_secs.append(secs)
        print(f'h={model.weight_h.shape[0]:3d} | epoch {e+1:02d}/{num_epochs} '
              f'| {secs:5.1f}s | Train {train_acc*100:5.2f}% '
              f'| Valid {valid_acc*100:5.2f}%')
    return epoch_loss, epoch_tr, epoch_va, epoch_secs

# ---------- 实验主体：h ∈ {10, 50, 100} ----------
results = {}
for num_hidden in [10, 50, 100]:
    np.random.seed(123)                 # 固定切批顺序，保证三组可比
    model = NeuralNetMLP(num_features=28*28,
                         num_hidden=num_hidden, num_classes=10)
    results[num_hidden] = train(model, X_train, y_train, X_valid,
                                y_valid, num_epochs=50)

# ---------- 可视化 ----------

    ax[0].plot(tr, label=f'train h={h}')
    ax[0].plot(va, '--', label=f'valid h={h}')

ax[1].set_ylabel('平均每轮耗时 (s)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('width_experiment.png', dpi=150)
print('图已保存到 ch11/width_experiment.png')
```

1. **准确率曲线**：h=10 的训练/验证曲线明显更低且更早饱和（容量瓶颈）；h=50 与 h=100 曲线接近，后者可能略高或基本持平——宽度收益递减。
2. **训练/验证间距**：三组模型的训练与验证曲线间隙都不大，说明在本任务规模下未出现明显过拟合；h=100 的间隙通常略大于 h=10（容量越大越有过拟合倾向）。
3. **耗时**：每轮耗时应大致随 h 线性增长（矩阵乘的计算量近似正比于参数量）；h=100 的每轮耗时应约是 h=10 的 8~10 倍量级、h=50 的约 2 倍。
4. **复现性**：三组实验都在 `np.random.seed(123)` 之后开始，切批顺序一致；又因 `NeuralNetMLP(random_seed=123)` 固定了初始权重，重复运行应得到相同曲线。

实验后的分析建议：把「最终验证准确率」和「平均每轮耗时」对 h 画散点，回答——为把准确率再抬 1 个百分点，多花的计算时间是否值得？这就是模型选型时最朴素的收益/成本权衡。

## 6. 本讲小结

- `minibatch_generator` 用「打乱下标 + `range(0, n-m+1, m)` 切批 + `yield` 惰性产出」实现数据阀门：每个 epoch 重新洗牌、只产出完整批、内存峰值只与批大小相关（55000 样本 ÷ 100 = 550 批/epoch）。
- `mse_loss`（可导，是 backward 的求导对象）与 `accuracy`（不可导，只做评估）分工明确；初始未训练模型的 MSE 应接近 0.25、准确率接近 10%，这是可以笔算出来的基线。
- `compute_mse_and_acc` 复用切批器对大数组做分批评估：一次 forward 同时算 MSE 与数对错；其 MSE 是「批均值的平均」，等批大小时才严格等于整体 MSE。
- `backward` 是链式法则的矩阵版：`delta_out = 2(a_out−y)/n ⊙ a_out(1−a_out)` 组合出输出层梯度后，经 `delta_out @ weight_out` 把误差传回隐藏层得到 `delta_h`，再分别与 `a_h`、`x` 相乘得到两组权重梯度、沿样本维求和得到两组偏置梯度；误差信号被复用、前向激活被复用，是「反向传播」得名的由来。
- `train` 把上述零件组装成 mini-batch SGD：逐批「forward → backward → 四组参数同时 `-= lr*梯度`」，epoch 末测量记录；`np.random.seed(123)` 固定切批顺序保证可复现。
- 数值梯度检验（中心差分 vs 解析梯度）是验证手写 backward 的标准手段；注意 `backward` 的损失约定除以 n 而非 n×C，相差常数倍 C，会被学习率吸收。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

本讲结束，你已经完整拥有一个「纯 numpy 的两层神经网络 + 训练器」。它暴露了三个痛点，恰好是下一单元（第 12 章，PyTorch 入门）逐一解决的：

1. **手写梯度太苦**：`backward` 的每一行矩阵运算都要自己推导、自己检验。PyTorch 的 autograd 只需写 `loss.backward()`（u12-l3），四组梯度自动填进 `.grad`。
2. **权重散落各处**：`weight_h`、`bias_h`…是裸 numpy 数组，更新要逐个写。`nn.Module`（u12-l3）把参数收编成 `parameters()`，优化器一步更新全部。
3. **数据管线手搓**：`minibatch_generator` 只会切批。`Dataset` + `DataLoader`（u12-l2）提供 shuffle、多进程加载、图像目录数据集等成套设施。

建议按顺序学习 u12-l1（张量基础）→ u12-l2（Dataset/DataLoader）→ u12-l3（nn.Module 与 autograd 下的 XOR 实验）。届时可以回头把本讲的 MNIST 实验用 PyTorch 重写，对比两种实现的代码量与训练速度，这个对比本身就是最好的复习。

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.
